name: Exp_MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud
summary: This EA trades based on the MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud custom indicator, which generates buy signals from its upper cloud buffer and sell signals from its lower cloud buffer. It opens and closes positions on new bar signals with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The strategy also searches historical bars to determine the last trading direction for position closing when no immediate close signal is present.
summary_zh: 该EA基于MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud自定义指标进行交易，从指标云图上轨缓冲区生成买入信号，下轨缓冲区生成卖出信号。它在新K线出现时根据信号开仓和平仓，支持可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈。当没有即时平仓信号时，策略还会搜索历史K线来确定最后的交易方向以获取平仓信号。
strategy_analysis: 策略基于MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud自定义指标的动量信号进行交易决策。入场条件：当指标第4缓冲区（上轨云图）在指定K线上出现非零非空值时触发买入信号，当第5缓冲区（下轨云图）出现非零非空值时触发卖出信号。出场条件：买入信号同时触发空头平仓，卖出信号同时触发多头平仓；若当前无直接平仓信号，则回溯历史K线寻找最近一次反向信号作为平仓依据。仓位管理通过MM参数控制资金使用比例，支持多种保证金模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损比例、固定手数）。资金管理采用固定止损1000点和止盈2000点的简单点数方式，配合最大滑点限制。策略仅在H4等多周期时间框架上运行，以新K线出现为触发条件，避免逐tick重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy trades based on momentum signals from the MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud custom indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when buffer 4 (upper cloud) shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE on the specified signal bar; a sell signal is triggered when buffer 5 (lower cloud) shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE. Exit conditions: a buy signal simultaneously triggers short position closure, and a sell signal triggers long position closure; if no direct close signal exists, the EA searches backward through historical bars to find the most recent opposite signal for closing. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which determines the share of financial resources, supporting multiple margin modes including free margin, balance, loss share, and fixed lot. Money management uses simple fixed stop loss at 1000 points and take profit at 2000 points, combined with a maximum price deviation of 10 points. The strategy operates on higher timeframes like H4 and only executes trades on new bar appearances to avoid redundant per-tick trading.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易中使用的资金份额比例
parameters.description_en: Fraction of capital used in trading

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数确定方法（自由保证金/余额/亏损比例/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot sizing method (free margin/balance/loss ratio/fixed lot)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 新K线触发机制避免逐tick重复交易，减少过度交易风险
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活性较高
具有止损和止盈设置，基本风险控制完善
信号生成后先平反向仓位再开新仓位，逻辑清晰
使用IsNewBar机制和Recount标志确保信号可靠性
pros_en: New bar trigger mechanism avoids per-tick redundant trading, reducing overtrading risk
Supports multiple money management modes with good flexibility
Has stop loss and take profit settings with basic risk control in place
Clear logic: closes opposite positions before opening new ones after signal generation
Uses IsNewBar mechanism and Recount flag to ensure signal reliability
cons: 依赖自定义指标MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud，指标逻辑不透明，难以验证策略有效性
历史K线回溯搜索平仓信号逻辑复杂且效率低，可能导致不必要的延迟平仓
止损1000点和止盈2000点数值较大但未考虑市场波动性（ATR），属于静态风控
缺少持仓检查，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
未考虑点差和手续费对交易成本的影响
cons_en: Depends on custom MUV_NorDIFF_Cloud indicator whose logic is opaque, making strategy validation difficult
Historical bar backward search for close signals is complex and inefficient, potentially causing delayed exits
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are static without considering market volatility (ATR)
Lacks position existence check, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Does not account for spread and commission impacts on trading costs
improvements: 增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同向重复开仓
使用ATR动态调整止损止盈，替代固定点数值
优化历史K线回溯平仓逻辑，增加最大回溯深度限制防止性能问题
增加点差过滤，避免在点差过大时开仓
improvements_en: Add position existence check to avoid duplicate entries in the same direction
Use ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit instead of fixed point values
Optimize historical bar backward search for close signals by adding a maximum lookback depth limit
Add spread filter to avoid opening positions when spread is excessively wide

risk_points: 缺少同向持仓检查，可能导致重复开仓增加风险敞口
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性，在极端行情下可能不足以控制风险
历史K线回溯平仓无深度限制，可能产生意外的平仓信号
risk_points_en: Lacks same-direction position check, potentially duplicating positions and increasing risk exposure
Fixed stop loss and take profit without volatility consideration may be insufficient during extreme market conditions
Unlimited historical bar backward search for close signals may generate unexpected closing triggers

It opens and closes positions on new bar signals with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The strategy also searches historical bars to determine the last trading direction for position closing when no immediate close signal is present.
